The purpose of implementing this protection for women and children victims of violence is to provide protection and services to women and children victims of violence that is based on gender and the best interests of the child, which occurs in the household and/or public sphere.
Therefore, the government of West Southeast Maluku Regency is obligated to provide protection to women and children victims of acts of violence which is an implementation of various laws and regulations, including Law Number 39 Year 1999 concerning Human Rights, Law Number 23 Year 2004 concerning the Elimination of Domestic Violence, Law Number 21 Year 2007 concerning the Eradication of the Crime of Trafficking in Persons, Law Number 23 Year 2002 concerning Child Protection.
1.1.rationale: The policy explicitly covers violence occurring in the household sphere and references the Elimination of Domestic Violence law, indicating domestic violence is included within its scope.
